scope: Production hardening and deployment readiness only; frozen RAG ranking, generation, evidence, citation, entity, corpus, and evaluation behavior was not redesigned.
changes_made: Made frontend demo data opt-in only; the exact value NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true enables demo mode and false/absent/malformed values use the live API.
Applied an exact HTTPS BIS/LIMS source-host allow-list to every external-source link surface.
Added bounded request bodies, generated request IDs, redacted validation/errors, strict production CORS parsing, and a bounded data-root resolver.
Added structured privacy-conscious request, retrieval, assessment, generation, and failure events without request bodies, full queries, credentials, or authorization headers.
Added liveness and readiness endpoints which distinguish process, retrieval assets, models, and optional provider configuration.
Replaced the frontend development-container command with a production multi-stage build/start configuration.
Disabled Next 16's experimental native TypeScript CLI because it failed to parse the generated route configuration; the standard TypeScript build path passes.
Documented platform-neutral backend/frontend deployment, environment separation, frozen model assets, and measured resource requirements.

known_limitations: Gemini credentials were absent, so no live provider request was made; the real boundary and missing/auth/timeout/malformed-output behavior remain covered by deterministic tests.
Readiness verifies provider configuration presence, not remote Gemini reachability, to avoid making health depend on a billable external request.
Cold readiness intentionally loads both frozen retrieval models and can take several seconds; orchestration probes need an appropriate initial delay/timeout.

Application-level authentication, authorization, and rate limiting are not part of the current single-user MVP and must be supplied before multi-user exposure, normally at the gateway plus an authenticated application layer.
The frontend source allow-list is intentionally exact; a new authoritative BIS/LIMS hostname requires explicit review and a code/test update.
The existing FastAPI TestClient/httpx deprecation warning remains and does not affect runtime behavior.
